new: Reach SpaleStudio from your phone with one password, set under Settings → Web access. No account, no sign-up — it is your machine.
Choose how many devices may be signed in at once, or set it to unlimited. When the last place is taken the next browser is turned away rather than quietly pushing someone off.
See what is connected. Settings lists every signed-in browser, marks the one you are on, and signs any of them out on its own.
If your licence lapses while you are working, SpaleStudio says so and opens SpaleHub on the screen that fixes it — the key, or this computer.
fixed: The welcome screen finally matches the theme you picked. Every colour on it follows the accent, so pink is pink and light is light.
Typing the web password no longer lands you on a second sign-in screen.
The AI that powers the editor is presented as a choice between models, not as one with a status light bolted to it.

new: Uđi u SpaleStudio sa telefona jednom lozinkom, iz Settings → Web access. Bez naloga i bez registracije — to je tvoja mašina.
Izaberi koliko uređaja može biti prijavljeno odjednom, ili stavi neograničeno. Kad se popuni, sledeći pregledač se odbija umesto da tiho izbaci nekoga.
Vidi šta je povezano. Settings izlistava svaki prijavljen pregledač, označi onaj na kom si, i odjavljuje bilo koji pojedinačno.
Ako licenca istekne dok radiš, SpaleStudio to kaže i otvori SpaleHub na ekranu koji to rešava — ključ, ili ovaj računar.
fixed: Početni ekran se konačno slaže sa temom koju si izabrao. Svaka boja na njemu prati akcenat, pa je roze roze a svetla tema svetla.
Posle unete web lozinke više te ne dočekuje drugi ekran za prijavu.
AI koji pokreće editor je predstavljen kao izbor između modela, a ne kao jedan sa zalepljenom lampicom statusa.
Clicking a news notification opens the item it was about. It used to just raise the window and leave you to find it.
Klik na notifikaciju o novostima otvara baš tu vest. Ranije bi samo podigao prozor i ostavio te da je sam tražiš.

new: Bring your own model. Add an Anthropic or OpenAI key, or point SpaleStudio at a model running on your own machine — llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM. Settings → AI & Agents.
Keys are encrypted with a key your operating system holds, in this app's folder. They never enter your project and never leave the computer.
Split a terminal to the right or below it, from the buttons in its header or with Ctrl+\ and Ctrl+Shift+\. The new pane opens in the same folder.
Pick None and SpaleStudio's own AI is genuinely off. Your agents are their own programs and carry on as they are.
fixed: The tray switches work. Turning the tray on puts the icon there now, turning it off takes it away, and minimise-to-close and start-minimised are remembered.
Run → Create New File makes the file and opens it. If a folder has to be trusted first, it says so instead of doing nothing.
The editor's Auto theme follows the pink theme instead of turning white in a dark window.
Claude tells you it is finished only for terminals inside SpaleStudio, and no longer interrupts a prompt in any other terminal.
Turn Log agent input off and it stops recording the terminals you already have open.
Saved logs list the sessions you actually typed in, not every terminal ever opened.
Copy buttons copy.
gone: Web access and the phone interface.
The Updates panel and its news feed.
Spotify. The local player, playlists and queue are untouched.

new: Dovedi svoj model. Dodaj Anthropic ili OpenAI ključ, ili uperi SpaleStudio u model koji vrti na svojoj mašini — llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM. Settings → AI & Agents.
Ključevi su šifrovani ključem koji drži tvoj operativni sistem, u folderu ove aplikacije. Nikad ne ulaze u projekat i ne napuštaju računar.
Rascepi terminal desno ili ispod, dugmadima u njegovom zaglavlju ili sa Ctrl+\ i Ctrl+Shift+\. Novi panel se otvara u istom folderu.
Izaberi None i SpaleStudio-ov AI je stvarno ugašen. Tvoji agenti su svoji programi i rade kao i pre.
fixed: Tray prekidači rade. Uključivanje sad stvarno stavi ikonicu, gašenje je skloni, a minimizuj-na-zatvaranje i pokreni-minimizovano se pamte.
Run → Create New File napravi fajl i otvori ga. Ako folder prvo mora da bude trusted, to i kaže umesto da se ništa ne desi.
Auto tema u editoru prati pink temu umesto da pobeli u tamnom prozoru.
Claude javlja da je gotov samo za terminale unutar SpaleStudia, i više ne prekida kucanje u bilo kom drugom terminalu.
Ugasi Log agent input i prestaje da snima terminale koje već imaš otvorene.
Sačuvani logovi izlistavaju sesije u kojima si stvarno kucao, a ne svaki ikad otvoren terminal.
Dugmad za kopiranje kopiraju.
gone: Updates panel i njegov feed vesti.
Spotify. Lokalni plejer, plejliste i red su netaknuti.

fixed: A button inside a notification is clickable again while the project picker is open.
Dugme u obaveštenju se opet može kliknuti dok je otvoren izbor projekta.

new: Drop a file from Explorer onto a terminal and its path lands at the cursor, ready to send.
Right-click a terminal to rename it, or to move it to another folder.
Auto mode drives the agent's own mode where it has one, and reads its footer back to confirm.
When an agent stops to ask permission, the question and its options arrive as a notification you can answer from.
Game mode: while a full-screen game is in front, nothing takes focus and notifications wait for you.
Low CPU mode in Settings, for machines where SpaleStudio is not the only thing running.
fixed: The Layout panel's grid buttons rearranged nothing — they wrote to a field the dock never read.
Files dropped on a terminal were refused outright.

new: Prevuci fajl iz Explorera na terminal i putanja padne na kurzor, spremna za slanje.
Desni klik na terminal za preimenovanje ili promenu foldera.
Auto mode pali agentov sopstveni režim tamo gde ga ima, i čita njegov footer da potvrdi.
Kad agent stane da pita za dozvolu, pitanje i opcije stižu kao notifikacija iz koje možeš da odgovoriš.
Game mode: dok je fullscreen igra u prvom planu, ništa ne krade fokus a notifikacije te čekaju.
Low CPU mod u podešavanjima, za mašine gde SpaleStudio nije jedino što radi.
fixed: Dugmad za raspored u Layout panelu nisu premeštala ništa — pisala su u polje koje dock ne čita.
Fajlovi prevučeni na terminal su bili odbijani.

new: Your agents can talk to each other. Ask one what it is working on, or hand it a task, and the answer comes back — Claude, Codex, Gemini, any of them, in any combination.
Type @name and a message in any terminal to send it to another agent, without leaving the one you are in.
A skill for Claude Code, so it knows the other agents are there and can reach them on its own. Tick it during setup.
SpaleStudio now checks what your computer is missing — agent CLIs, Android tools, adb drivers — and installs the ones you choose, in the right order, wherever you want them.
Crash reports and feedback arrive as messages you can read inside SpaleStudio, encrypted so only your computer can open them.
Updates arrive on their own, including the moment you are back online after your laptop has been shut for days.
fixed: Installed tools that the terminal could not find are now spotted and fixed with one click.
The activation screen was unreadable and asked for the wrong key format.

new: Agenti mogu da pričaju međusobno. Pitaj jednog šta radi ili mu daj zadatak, i odgovor stiže — Claude, Codex, Gemini, bilo koji, u bilo kojoj kombinaciji.
Ukucaj @ime i poruku u bilo kom terminalu i ode drugom agentu, bez izlaska iz onog u kom si.
Skill za Claude Code, da sam zna da su ostali agenti tu i da može da ih dohvati. Štikliraj ga u setup-u.
SpaleStudio sada proverava šta ti fali na računaru — agent CLI-jeve, Android alate, adb drajvere — i instalira ono što izabereš, pravim redosledom, gde god hoćeš.
Crash izveštaji i feedback stižu kao poruke koje čitaš u SpaleStudio-u, šifrovane tako da ih samo tvoj računar može otvoriti.
Apdejti stižu sami, i čim se vratiš online posle laptopa koji je bio zatvoren danima.
fixed: Alati koji su instalirani ali ih terminal ne vidi sada se prepoznaju i sređuju jednim klikom.
Ekran za aktivaciju je bio nečitljiv i tražio pogrešan format ključa.

new: Claude tells you itself when it has finished and when it needs your permission. SpaleStudio used to guess from what the terminal printed, which is why it kept saying "finished" while Claude was still thinking. Turn it on in Settings → Notifications.
A pink theme, warm rather than sweet — now in Settings → Appearance, where you would look for it.
Web access has its own page in Settings instead of sitting at the foot of Integrations under Spotify and Git.
fixed: Release notes in the News Center were printing their own HTML tags.
Opening this from your phone or browser now needs a licence, the same as opening it here.
A folder opened read-only can no longer have anything run in it — the prompt always said so, and now it is true.
Cloning a repository into a new folder asks you first instead of refusing, and refuses outright anywhere it should never write.

new: Claude ti sam javi kad je završio i kad mu treba tvoja dozvola. SpaleStudio je do sada pogađao iz onoga što terminal ispisuje, pa je zato javljao „gotovo" dok je Claude još razmišljao. Uključi se u Settings → Notifications.
Pink tema, topla a ne slatkasta — sada u Settings → Appearance, tamo gde bi je i tražio.
Web pristup ima svoju stranu u Settings-u umesto da stoji na dnu Integrations-a ispod Spotifyja i Gita.
fixed: Beleške o izdanjima u News Center-u su ispisivale svoje HTML tagove.
Otvaranje sa telefona ili iz pregledača sada traži licencu, isto kao i otvaranje ovde.
U folderu otvorenom kao read-only više ništa ne može da se pokrene — prompt je to oduvek pisao, sada je i tačno.
Kloniranje repozitorijuma u nov folder te pita umesto da odbije, a odbija odmah tamo gde nikad ne bi smelo da piše.

new: Agent notifications stay off until Claude is reporting itself, and the page says so instead of leaving you with switches that quietly do nothing.
SpaleStudio knows whether SpaleHub is on this computer, so it stops pointing you at an add-on you have no way to reach.
fixed: Cloning a repository into a new folder asks you first instead of refusing.
A folder opened read-only can no longer have a terminal started in it — the prompt always promised that, and now it is true.

new: Obaveštenja agenata su isključena dok Claude ne javlja sam, i stranica to i kaže umesto da ti ostavi prekidače koji ćutke ne rade ništa.
SpaleStudio zna da li je SpaleHub na ovom računaru, pa te više ne šalje po add-on do kog nemaš kako da stigneš.
fixed: Kloniranje repozitorijuma u nov folder te pita umesto da odbije.
U folderu otvorenom kao read-only više ne može da se pokrene terminal — prompt je to oduvek obećavao, sada je i tačno.
Settings would not open in 1.4.1. It opens.
Opening SpaleStudio from your phone or browser now shows the app instead of "Cannot GET /" — the web interface was never being served in a released build.
The window no longer freezes for a moment when a folder asks to be trusted.
Terminals follow the pink theme instead of staying white.
Settings nije mogao da se otvori u 1.4.1. Otvara se.
Otvaranje SpaleStudija sa telefona ili iz pregledača sada prikazuje program umesto „Cannot GET /" — web interfejs nikada nije ni bio serviran u objavljenoj verziji.
Prozor se više ne zamrzne na trenutak kad folder traži poverenje.
Terminali prate pink temu umesto da ostanu beli.

new: The pink theme is pink everywhere — buttons, rings, scrollbars, tabs and terminals, not just the surfaces.
fixed: Settings would not open in 1.4.1. It opens.
Opening SpaleStudio from your phone or browser shows the app instead of "Cannot GET /" — the web interface was never being served in a released build.
The window no longer freezes for a moment when a folder asks to be trusted.
Settings headings no longer pile up on top of each other as you scroll.

new: Pink tema je roza svuda — dugmad, prstenovi, skrolbarovi, tabovi i terminali, ne samo površine.
fixed: Settings nije mogao da se otvori u 1.4.1. Otvara se.
Otvaranje SpaleStudija sa telefona ili iz pregledača prikazuje program umesto „Cannot GET /" — web interfejs nikada nije ni bio serviran u objavljenoj verziji.
Prozor se više ne zamrzne na trenutak kad folder traži poverenje.
Naslovi u Settings-u se više ne gomilaju jedan preko drugog dok skroluješ.

new: The welcome setup introduces itself on your first launch — close it once and it never comes back on its own.
Rename the project straight from the title bar — Edit project in the workspace menu.
Deleting the workspace you are in takes you back to the previous one.
fixed: SpaleStudio opens instantly — no more freezing for a few seconds right after launch.
The title bar shows the workspace you are actually in — and says so when there is none.
The crash report appears only after a real crash — never after an update or a forced close.

new: Uvodno podešavanje se predstavi pri prvom pokretanju — zatvoriš ga jednom i više se samo ne vraća.
Preimenovanje projekta direktno iz naslovne trake — Edit project u workspace meniju.
Brisanje workspace-a u kom si vraća te na prethodni.
fixed: SpaleStudio se otvara odmah — bez zamrzavanja na par sekundi posle pokretanja.
Naslovna traka pokazuje workspace u kom stvarno jesi — i kaže kad ga nema.
Prijava pada se pojavljuje samo posle pravog pada — nikad posle update-a ili prinudnog gašenja.

new: Claude notifications stay set up when SpaleStudio is closed and pick up again the moment it starts.
fixed: Nothing from SpaleStudio ever appears in an ordinary terminal — its Claude hooks act only inside SpaleStudio terminals, silently everywhere else.
The agent-messaging skill now says plainly when SpaleStudio is not running instead of showing a connection error.

new: Claude notifikacije ostaju podešene i kad je SpaleStudio ugašen — nastavljaju čim se pokrene.
fixed: Ništa iz SpaleStudija se više ne pojavljuje u običnom terminalu — Claude hook-ovi rade samo u SpaleStudio terminalima, svuda drugde su nemi.
Skill za dopisivanje agenata sada jasno kaže kad SpaleStudio nije pokrenut umesto greške o konekciji.

new: SpaleStudio says the moment SpaleHub is not running — a small notice with Open SpaleHub and Try again, and it clears itself when the hub is back.
fixed: Every licence message names the exact problem and the place that fixes it — SpaleHub.
Updates land cleanly — the app can no longer start on a stale cached copy of the previous version.

new: SpaleStudio kaže čim SpaleHub nije pokrenut — mala poruka sa Otvori SpaleHub i Pokušaj ponovo, koja se sama skloni kad se hub vrati.
fixed: Svaka poruka o licenci imenuje tačan problem i mesto koje ga rešava — SpaleHub.
Update se primenjuje čisto — aplikacija više ne može da se pokrene na starom keširanom primerku prethodne verzije.
The SpaleHub connection screen now shows the link between the two programs, and says it in a line instead of a paragraph.
Ekran za vezu sa SpaleHub-om sada prikazuje vezu između dva programa, i kaže to u jednoj liniji umesto u pasusu.

new: SpaleSwarm asks how big a grid you want and how many of each agent, then starts them together.
fixed: Agents start with no project open — launching one no longer refuses your own home folder.
When a folder does need your permission, SpaleStudio asks for it right there and finishes what you started.
Granting a folder is asked in SpaleStudio's own window, and it says exactly what it grants.

new: SpaleSwarm pita koliki grid hoćeš i koliko kog agenta, pa ih pokrene zajedno.
fixed: Agenti se pokreću i kad nema otvorenog projekta — više ne odbija tvoj sopstveni home folder.
Kad folder stvarno traži dozvolu, SpaleStudio je pita tu i dovrši ono što si započeo.
Davanje dozvole za folder pita SpaleStudio u svom prozoru, i kaže tačno šta daje.

new: SpaleAssist: ask about the code you have open, or say what to change. It answers with a diff you apply or discard, and it can run the file for you.
A terminal sits under your code, in the same window. Open as many as you need, and pick from the list when there are a lot.
The Run menu keeps what you run often — add a file, add a command, remove either.
Suggestions while you type: a dropdown built from your own file, and the AI finishing your line in grey. Tab takes it, Esc sends it away.
Choose which model each provider uses, from the list that provider actually offers.
fixed: Run starts straight away and tells you when it has finished, with the program's own exit code.
Run saves your file first, so you compile what is on screen.
Problems can be marked as read instead of deleted.
A file opens once, however its path is spelled.

new: SpaleAssist: pitaj za kod koji ti je otvoren, ili reci šta da promeni. Odgovara diffom koji prihvatiš ili odbaciš, i može da ti pokrene fajl.
Terminal stoji ispod koda, u istom prozoru. Otvori ih koliko ti treba, a kad ih je puno biraš iz liste.
Run meni pamti ono što često pokrećeš — dodaj fajl, dodaj komandu, obriši bilo šta od toga.
Predlozi dok kucaš: padajući spisak iz tvog fajla, i AI koji ti sivo dovršava red. Tab uzima, Esc odbacuje.
Biraš koji model koristi svaki provider, iz spiska koji taj provider stvarno nudi.
fixed: Run kreće odmah i javi kad je gotov, sa exit kodom samog programa.
Run prvo snimi fajl, pa kompajlira ono što vidiš.
Problemi mogu da se označe kao pročitani umesto da se brišu.
Fajl se otvara jednom, kako god da mu je napisana putanja.

new: SpaleAssist opens from the editor's header, beside the file it is talking about and next to the terminal that runs it.
The conversation stays. Your thread — and a change you looked at and did not apply — is still there the next time you open SpaleStudio, until you clear it.
A Claude subscription can pick its model, from the list the CLI itself offers.
SpaleAssist, AI & Agents and Claude Code have icons of their own instead of the same sparkle, and the Claude Code card shows a live dot when it is signed in.
The sidebar and the dock take their colours from your theme, all of them.
fixed: The emulator's hardware check tells the truth about virtualization: it says it is off in Windows when that is what it is, instead of reporting a machine that can do it as one that cannot.

new: SpaleAssist se otvara iz zaglavlja editora, pored fajla o kome priča i pored terminala koji ga pokreće.
Razgovor ostaje. Tvoja nit — i izmena koju si pogledao a nisi primenio — čeka te i sledeći put kad otvoriš SpaleStudio, dok je sam ne obrišeš.
Claude pretplata sad bira model, iz spiska koji sam CLI nudi.
SpaleAssist, AI & Agents i Claude Code imaju svoje ikonice umesto iste zvezdice, a kartica Claude Code pokazuje tačkicu kad je prijavljen.
Sidebar i dock uzimaju boje iz tvoje teme, sve do jedne.
fixed: Provera hardvera za emulator govori istinu o virtuelizaciji: kaže da je isključena u Windowsu kad je to slučaj, umesto da mašinu koja to ume prijavi kao da ne ume.

new: The Run menu lists the files you have open. Pick one and it runs — the one in the editor is marked, and the choice holds for F5 and the Run button too.
Choosing a file to run happens inside SpaleStudio now: your project, your places and your recent files in one picker, with the files nothing can run shown as such.
Run meni prikazuje fajlove koje imaš otvorene. Izabereš jedan i pokreće se — onaj u editoru je označen, a izbor važi i za F5 i za dugme Run.
Biranje fajla za pokretanje se sad dešava u samom SpaleStudiju: tvoj projekat, tvoja mesta i skorašnji fajlovi u jednom pickeru, a fajlovi koje ništa ne pokreće odmah se vide kao takvi.
Game mode lists the programs open right now by name and icon, with a search — instead of raw window titles like .NET-BroadcastEventWindow.
A game can also be chosen as a file. It is then matched on the file itself, so a title that gains a level, a server or a language cannot break it.
Your games show the program's real icon, the one Windows shows.
fixed: In the Android emulator settings the graphics options no longer run their description into their name, and the option you are on is marked again.
The hypervisor line reads as the machine fact it is: a tick and two words, next to the note that says what to do about it.

new: Game mode prikazuje programe koji su trenutno otvoreni, po imenu i ikonici, uz pretragu — umesto sirovih naslova prozora tipa .NET-BroadcastEventWindow.
Igra može da se izabere i kao fajl. Tada se prepoznaje po samom fajlu, pa naslov koji dobije nivo, server ili drugi jezik ne može da je pokvari.
Tvoje igre stoje sa pravom ikonicom programa, onom koju pokazuje i Windows.
fixed: U podešavanjima Android emulatora opis grafičke opcije se više ne lepi za naziv, a opcija na kojoj si ponovo je označena.
Red o hipervizoru izgleda kao podatak o mašini što i jeste: štiklica i dve reči, uz napomenu ispod koja kaže šta da se uradi.

new: An open file can be closed. The header above it carries an X now, on Ctrl+W as well — and Ctrl+W, like every in-app shortcut, can be changed in Settings → Keyboard.
A file can be pulled out into a window of its own, with SpaleAssist, its terminal and Run all inside that window. The button that used to hand the file to another program does this instead.
The project menu in the status bar lists your projects wherever you opened it from, scrolls when there are many, and its second action creates a workspace instead of promising one.
fixed: A detached window keeps its title bar at every size, and the row of on-screen keys that replaced it on a narrow window is gone.
A detached file has one title bar instead of two — the file's own row is the window's, and dragging it moves the window.

new: Otvoren fajl može da se zatvori. Zaglavlje iznad njega sad ima X, radi i Ctrl+W — a Ctrl+W, kao i svaka prečica u aplikaciji, menja se u Settings → Keyboard.
Fajl može da se izvuče u sopstveni prozor, sa SpaleAssistom, terminalom i Run-om unutar tog prozora. Dugme koje je fajl predavalo drugom programu sad radi to.
Meni projekata u statusnoj traci prikazuje tvoje projekte odakle god da si ga otvorio, skroluje kad ih je mnogo, a druga akcija pravi workspace umesto da ga obećava.
fixed: Odvojeni prozor zadržava svoju traku na svakoj veličini, a red tastera na ekranu koji ju je menjao u uskom prozoru je uklonjen.
Odvojeni fajl ima jednu traku umesto dve — njegov sopstveni red je traka prozora, i prevlačenjem se prozor pomera.
